posts.text: Doctors Without Borders (MSF) said that two of its colleagues, both watchmen, were killed in an Israeli strike on one of its clinics in Gaza, bringing the total number of its colleagues killed in the Strip to 17. In a post on X, the organization said the clinic was clearly marked with its logos and its location had been communicated to and was known by the Israeli military. "We stand in solidarity with the families and loved ones of our colleagues. We call for accountability," MSF wrote.
